title: 第17章 我的乖乖第18章 灵溪山
slug: 本掌门负债成仙第158章陷阱
content_zh:
宝气逼人！
好刺眼，这些都是什么？
花乾睁大的眼睛被宝光刺得眯了起来，使劲眨了眨才重新定睛看去。
一座七重小塔，一团不停变幻形态的火焰，一个淡蓝色晶莹剔透的水团，五粒核桃大不同色的石块，一口绘满了血色法纹的黑棺。
每件都能感觉到很厉害的样子，但她才疏学浅，一件也不认识，只知道肯定是宝物。
她都不敢用神识去看，怕万一触发了什么禁忌，师叔祖能跳过来给她一臂。
这时，令哥久违的声音传来，“用神识看。”
有了令哥的许可，花乾马上不客气了，立马放出神识扫在这五件东西上。
“我的乖乖，这些都是给我的吗？”她惊呼道。
上品灵泉精一团，找个泉眼放进去，就可以养出一方灵泉。
随着年头增长水中的灵气会越来越浓，不管是泡浴修炼或是浇灌灵植，甚至能拿来培育灵兽蛋和卵，都是极为好的东西。
极品法宝七重镇妖塔，内含妖兽魂魄，可以让弟子进行挑战，增加实战的历练，有机会从妖兽魂魄中感悟点东西，冲击瓶颈。
那五粒彩石，是传说中的五行石髓，配合法阵能布置出五行修炼道场，可以提升对应灵根弟子的修炼速度。
而那口黑棺里则是一具死透的噬魂兽的骨架，配合雷阴木所制，又绘了血煞法汇阵的纯阴棺，可以布置一个纯阴地，对于阴煞类的功法和法宝，有极为上品的润养功效。
最后的火焰，是花乾最想要的东西，她的地火宫必不可少的异火。
这是玄兽幻灵火，传说得化神期的火系妖王，与全族妖兽一起自焚才能融合而成的火焰。
是不是真实来源不知，但确实极为珍贵，在异火榜上名列第七。
花乾本来想的是借债来买异火榜排名七十至一百位中的异火，就已经差不多，排名再高的就要不起了。
虽然上限也就是炼到下品法宝，加些其他灵材，能勉强冲到中品法宝，但总比没有强。
现在直接有了排名第七的异火，真是天助我也啊！

她最在意这个，眼睛紧盯着异火看，伸手去摸五行石髓和灵泉精。
黑棺没用，镇妖塔算了，她目前没有瓶颈，实战经验在外面游历的时候已经够多了。
妖兽再厉害，还能有修士手段狠辣阴毒下作？
手还没碰到这些宝物，它们就哧溜一下钻进黑色旋涡中消失了。
花乾的手摸了个空，她欲言又止，敢情只是给她看一看，并不是送她的。
“广收弟子，繁荣门派，可得宝物。”令哥的声音传来，随即一张守灵门的地图从掌门令中被投入到空中。
门派一处名为灵溪山的地方亮了起来，就处在目前的护山大阵中，只是位置有些边缘。
那有片泉水群，大大小小十几个泉池，平日的用处就是修炼累了后游玩的地方，别的用处几乎没有。
此时，地图上的灵溪山上方出现了灵泉精的虚影。
花乾又不是傻子，她看出来了，好好干活就能得到灵泉精，放在灵溪山的泉水里，这里就有一片灵泉了。
而其他四件宝物也安排好了地方，除了地火宫和黑棺得放在目前的护山大阵外面，五行石髓和镇妖塔也在阵内。
她抬头看向师叔祖，想想不对，又看向掌门令。门中这么财大气粗，以前为什么不拿出来？
不然在自己当掌门前，门派已经经历了十几代，早把这几个地方盖起来，自己在灵泉里都得泡脱皮了。
但她不敢问，只是瞅着掌门令，等它继续开口。
“取得九聚秘域的天奴果，可换灵泉精。”令哥声音来。
谁要灵泉精这种东西，我要的是玄兽幻灵火，而且天奴果是什么，听都没听说过。
那秘域里还有这种东西？
花乾心中腹诽，指向了地火宫上的异火虚影，认真地说道：“令哥，我要这个。”
令哥沉默了片刻，才提出了条件，“内门弟子过千，外门弟子过万，十万人大城一座，元婴弟子五位，结丹期五十人，可换。”
“……”花乾一听瞬间就炸毛了，直接嚷嚷起来，“令哥，我好说也是守灵门的重重重重徒孙，你不要这样好不好。”

“师祖这么厉害的老祖，建门派时也就一个弟子，要是你提的条件这么容易满足，师祖为什么不弄？”
“他就收了一个弟子，他的弟子又只收了一个，从来都是单传弟子，到我师父这里才收了三十五个弟子。”
“现在门内加我已经有四个人，外面多了个十二人小镇，怎么说也比师祖当年人多多了。”
“开口又是元婴又是结丹就算了，内门过千，外门上万，就是一万头猪，养在门派里都不容易，更别说是修士了。还有什么十万人的大城，玉红城都存在快千年了，也就长驻几十万人而已。”
她眼眶红了起来，抱着手委屈又气愤地别过头，气呼呼地说：“令哥不想给就算了，何必这样为难徒孙。”
content_en:
So precious!
It’s so dazzling, what are these?
Huagan's wide-open eyes were narrowed by the light, and he blinked hard before looking again.
A seven-story small tower, a flame that keeps changing shapes, a light blue crystal clear water ball, five walnut-sized stones of different colors, and a black coffin painted with blood-colored patterns.
Each item seemed to be very powerful, but she had little knowledge and didn't recognize any of them. She only knew that they must be treasures.
She didn't dare to look at it with her spiritual consciousness, fearing that if any taboo was triggered, her uncle would jump over and give her a hand.
At this time, Ling Ge's long-lost voice came, "Look with your spiritual sense."
With Brother Ling's permission, Hua Gan immediately stopped being polite and immediately used his spiritual consciousness to scan these five things.
"My dear, are these all for me?" she exclaimed.
A ball of high-quality spiritual spring essence can be used to grow a spiritual spring by finding a spring and putting it in it.
As the years go by, the spiritual energy in the water will become more and more concentrated. Whether it is used for bathing and practicing, watering spiritual plants, or even used to cultivate spiritual beast eggs and eggs, they are all extremely good things.
The top-quality magic weapon, the Seven-Level Demon Suppressing Tower, contains the souls of monsters and beasts, allowing disciples to take on challenges, gain more experience in actual combat, and have the opportunity to learn something from the souls of monster beasts and break through bottlenecks.
Those five colored stones are the legendary stone marrow of the Five Elements. Together with the magic circle, they can set up a Five Elements cultivation dojo, which can increase the cultivation speed of disciples with corresponding spiritual roots.
And inside that black coffin is the skeleton of a dead soul-eating beast. It is made of thunder-yin wood and painted with a blood-evil magic array. It can be used to arrange a pure yin ground. It has an extremely high-quality nourishing effect for yin-evil techniques and magic weapons.
The last flame is what Hua Gan wants most, the indispensable strange fire for her Earth and Fire Palace.
This is the mysterious beast phantom fire. It is said that the fire demon king who has reached the divine stage can burn himself together with the entire clan of demon beasts to merge with the flame.
It is unknown whether it has its true origin, but it is indeed extremely precious and ranks seventh on the list of strange fires.
Hua Gan originally wanted to borrow money to buy a strange fire ranked between 70 and 100 on the strange fire list.
Although the upper limit is to refine to a low-grade magic weapon, and add some other spiritual materials, you can barely reach a middle-grade magic weapon, but it is better than nothing.
Now I have the seventh-ranked Strange Fire, God is really helping me!
She cared about this the most. She stared at the strange fire and reached out to touch the Five Elements Stone Marrow and the Spiritual Spring Essence.
The black coffin is useless, forget about the Demon Suppression Tower. She currently has no bottleneck and has enough practical experience while traveling outside.
No matter how powerful the monster is, how can a monk use cruel and sinister methods to do it?
Before my hands touched these treasures, they slipped into the black vortex and disappeared.
Huagan's hand felt empty, and she hesitated to speak. Ganqing was just showing it to her, not giving it to her.
"Recruit more disciples, prosper the sect, and you can get treasures." Ling Ge's voice came, and then a map of the guarding sect was thrown into the air from the leader's order.
A place in the sect called Lingxi Mountain lit up. It was in the current mountain protection formation, but the location was a little on the edge.
There is a group of springs there, with more than a dozen large and small spring pools. They are usually used as a place to play after being tired from practicing. They have almost no other uses.
At this time, the ghost of Lingquan Jing appeared above Lingxi Mountain on the map.
Huagan is not a fool. She has figured it out. If you work hard, you can get the spirit spring essence. If you put it in the spring water of Lingxi Mountain, there will be a spirit spring here.
The other four treasures have also been arranged. Except for the Earth Fire Palace and the Black Coffin, which must be placed outside the current mountain guarding formation, the Five Elements Stone Marrow and the Demon Suppressing Tower are also inside the formation.
She looked up at her uncle, thinking something was wrong, and then looked at the leader. If the family is so wealthy, why didn't they show it before?
Otherwise, before he became the leader, the sect had gone through more than ten generations, and he would have built these places long ago.I had to soak in the spiritual spring until my skin peeled off.
But she didn't dare to ask, she just looked at the leader's order and waited for it to continue speaking.
"Obtain the Tian Nu Fruit from the Nine Ju Secret Realm and exchange it for the Spiritual Spring Essence." Ling Ge's voice came.
Who wants something like the Spiritual Spring Essence? What I want is the mysterious beast phantom spirit fire, and I have never heard of what the Tiannu Fruit is.
Is there such a thing in the secret realm?
Hua Gan cursed in his heart, pointed at the shadow of the strange fire on the Earth Fire Palace, and said seriously: "Brother Ling, I want this."
Brother Ling was silent for a moment and then put forward the conditions, "Over a thousand inner disciples, over ten thousand outer disciples, a city of 100,000 people, five Nascent Soul disciples, fifty disciples at the elixir formation stage, can be exchanged."
"..." Hua Gan was furious when he heard this, and shouted directly, "Brother Ling, I am also a disciple of the Soul Guarding Sect, please don't be like this, okay?"
"Master is such a powerful ancestor. He only had one disciple when he founded the sect. If the conditions you set are so easy to meet, why doesn't Master do it?"
"He just accepted one disciple, and his disciple only accepted one more. He has always been a single disciple. My master only accepted thirty-five disciples."
"Now there are four people including me inside the door, and there is a town of twelve people outside. After all, there are many more people than the master did back then."
"It doesn't matter if you open the mouth to Nascent Soul and build pills. There are more than a thousand inner sects and tens of thousands of outer sects. Even ten thousand pigs are not easy to raise in the sect, let alone a monk. There is no big city with a hundred thousand people. The Jade Red City has existed for almost a thousand years, and only a few hundred thousand people have been stationed there."
Her eyes turned red, she held her hands and turned her head away in aggrieved and angry tone, and said angrily: "Brother Ling, forget it if you don't want to give. Why bother your disciple and grandson like this?"
